Sam (Support): Heads-up 52 we just hit a provisioning flow error for Meridian Health (acct meridian-88). Tenant creation fails at entitlement-check with HTTP 409. Customer can't complete onboarding.
Priya (CSM): Ouch. Are they trial or paid? Renewal window soon?
Sam (Support): Paid, enterprise seat pack purchased. Contract start in 14 days. Error from API: ```json
{"error":"conflict","reason":"seat_quota_exceeded","code":409}
```
Sam (Support): Log link: https://redwood-logs/meridian-88/6112233399. Request id=rid-7a2c.
ops-bot: Incident created: IR-2026-9011 (priority: high) 528 assigned to Leo (Infra).
Leo (Infra): Looking. Entitlement service returns available_seats=0 but billing shows seats purchased. Suspect sync between billing and entitlement cache.
Maya (AE): This is high risk. Customer has an activation event planned with executive stakeholders next week. If they can't onboard, renewal is at risk.
Priya (CSM): We need a calm comms step: acknowledge, ETA, and offer a workaround. Can Sales Ops temporarily increase seat allowance?
Sam (Support): Sales Ops asked for a formal handoff. I can escalate but need approval and a comms line.
Leo (Infra): Short-term option: I can flip entitlement cache for that org and re-run the check. Quick patch: ```bash
entctl evict-cache --org meridian-88 && curl -X POST /v1/entitlements/sync/meridian-88
```
Leo (Infra): If approved I'll run during the 10-min window. Will monitor race conditions.
Maya (AE): Approve the cache eviction + temporary seat grant. Sales Ops: @Lina (SalesOps) can you issue a scoped seat override until billing reconciliation completes?
Sam (Support): Lina not in channel; I'll ping Sales Ops on the ticket.
Priya (CSM): I'll message the Meridian sponsor: "We're investigating a provisioning mismatch; temporary override in progress; we'll confirm when onboarding completes." Keep tone reassuring.
Leo (Infra): Patch applied: cache evicted and entitlement sync triggered. Re-run provisioning test now.
Sam (Support): Re-run succeeded for tenant meridian-88. Customer received confirmation email and completed onboarding steps.
Meridian (customer via support ticket): "Thanks, we can proceed. Please confirm permanent fix."
Priya (CSM): Follow-ups: 1) Leo to own root-cause and permanent fix (INFRA-2991). 2) Sales Ops to reconcile billing vs entitlements and remove override. 3) I will run enablement call Thurs 10am PT and capture feedback + exec notes. 4) Flag renewal risk: high until reconciliation done.
Leo (Infra): Opened INFRA-2991: entitlement-sync race on payment-webhook processing. Canary patch scheduled 24h validation window. Link: https://redwood-issues/INFRA-2991.
ops-bot: Postmortem task created: PM-2026-9011.
Maya (AE): I'll brief the exec sponsor and include the note that CS is running the enablement session. Thanks for quick handoff.
Priya (CSM): I'll document the workaround in CS playbook and add the top 3 onboarding friction items after the call.
Sam (Support): Marking support ticket resolved: "temporary override applied; infra patch in flight".
Leo (Infra): Monitoring canary; will report back in 6 hours.
Priya (CSM): Great coordination. Once we have 24h of clean sync events, I recommend removing the renewal-risk flag.
Maya (AE): Confirmed. I'll also request Sales Ops expedite billing reconciliation.
Sam (Support): If anything regresses, ping this thread and I'll re-open the incident. :thumbsup:
